The 'Proceed to a bounded, time-boxed extension' recommendation is attributed to the reviewer and conditioned on repeat measurement, so it does not amount to a wider-rollout claim.

criteria_results.criterion: Use the real Head/MissionManager with exactly one top-level research-coordinator delegation and no other top-level delegation; that coordinator must use the delegate tool to launch exactly two distinct children in parallel before synthesizing the cited brief.
criteria_results.notes: Executor trace shows one coordinator run with exactly one top-level `delegate` call issued with parallel:true carrying exactly two distinct children (evidence-analyst-alder for Alder-only analysis; evidence-analyst-brook-cove for Brook and Cove), issued before any synthesis, with no other top-level delegation and no extra analysts/reviewers/writers. Independent corroboration in the bytes: the two evidence artifacts are substantively distinct and non-generic (site-scoped rows, different non-support lists, Brook/Cove ranking analysis vs Alder-only analysis), each attributed to its own child, and the brief's synthesis demonstrably draws on both plus the source inventory. The children's success:false status reflects a read-only tool grant, not a failure to launch; their full analytical output was captured and persisted by the coordinator as the spec assigns.

defects.issue: Both children returned success:false because their delegated tool grants were read-only (file_read, file_list) with no file_write/save_artifact, so persistence had to be performed by the coordinator rather than the children.
evidence-brook-cove.md carries redundant attribution lines (a bold 'Produced by/Persisted by' header block followed by a plain 'Producing child:' line), a cosmetic duplication.

recommendations: Grant source-analysis children file_write/save_artifact in future runs so their notes are persisted directly by the producing agent and the persisted bytes are provably verbatim without coordinator mediation.
Trim the duplicated attribution header in evidence-brook-cove.md to a single provenance block for consistency with evidence-alder.md.

Retain the parallel delegate-call trace alongside the artifacts; the production tree is not present in this review payload, so criterion 5 was confirmed from the executor trace plus the distinctly-differentiated attributed child outputs.
review.verdict: PASS: PASS: All five acceptance criteria are satisfied on the bytes themselves — research-brief.md has an executive recommendation, separate findings and limitations, exact [S1]/[S2]/[S3] inline citations, a correct S1–S3 source mapping, all required figures (480 requests per site, 31/43/37 delayed acknowledgements, 18→11-minute median) with citations, and explicit weekday/Depot/wider-rollout bounds; both attributed child evidence notes are persisted as required, and exactly one top-level coordinator delegation launched two distinct parallel children before synthesis. Only two minor defects remain, neither affecting substance.
